one_liner: Workplace chat platform with a broad Web API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 installs yield user, bot and app tokens (sent as Bearer).
access_notes: Register an app at api.slack.com/apps; free workspace suffices for dev. Marketplace listing only needed for public distribution/MCP.
api_notes: Web API has 200+ HTTP methods; Socket Mode/Events not confirmed on fetched page.

one_liner: Programmable messaging, voice and email APIs.
auth_notes: HTTP Basic with API key SID/secret (recommended) or Account SID/Auth Token.
access_notes: Free trial (30 days) gives same Account SID/Auth Token; limited to verified recipients/templates; paid upgrade for production.
api_notes: 1,800+ endpoints across 30+ products per MCP docs.

one_liner: Zoho's team chat with REST API and official MCP.
auth_notes: Zoho OAuth 2.0; register client in Zoho developer console; scopes ZohoCliq.<Module>.<ACTION>.
access_notes: Client registration in Zoho API console is self-serve; free-plan availability not confirmed on fetched pages.
api_notes: Users, chats, channels, messages, bots, files, calls, events, DB; 5-30 req/min per endpoint.

one_liner: Lark Open Platform with IM, calendar, docs APIs and official MCP.
auth_notes: tenant/app access tokens from app ID+secret; user_access_token via OAuth 2.0 (per MCP README). Docs site is JS-rendered; details from GitHub README.
access_notes: Create app on open.larksuite.com for App ID/Secret; needs a Lark tenant. Intl vs Feishu apps not interchangeable.
api_notes: Large OpenAPI surface (IM, calendar, docs, etc.); exact endpoint docs not readable via fetch.

one_liner: Free Slack-like chat with API-key add-on and OAuth app SDK.
auth_notes: API-key add-on (all plans) or OAuth2 for apps (client ID/secret from app manifest).
access_notes: Install API add-on and generate key; available on all plans for Owner/Admin/Member.
api_notes: Send/reply/delete messages, reactions, create channels, list channels/messages; 1000 req/min.

one_liner: Chat platform with bot and OAuth2 REST API plus Gateway.
auth_notes: Bot token from developer portal; OAuth2 code/client-credentials grants.
access_notes: Create app in Developer Portal. Some scopes (dm_channels.read, voice, rpc) partner-only; privileged intents need verification at scale.
api_notes: REST routes plus real-time Gateway.

one_liner: Bot API over HTTPS with BotFather tokens.
auth_notes: Per-bot token from BotFather embedded in URL path.
access_notes: Create bot via BotFather instantly; no approval.
api_notes: Large method set: messaging, media, polls, payments, business, mini apps; updates via polling/webhook. User-account (TDLib) API not assessed.

one_liner: Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
auth_notes: Access tokens; permanent system-user token with whatsapp_business_messaging/management permissions.
access_notes: Meta developer account + app + test number is free; production use needs business portfolio, number registration, and app review/business verification for others' accounts; conversation pricing applies.
api_notes: Messaging, templates, phone numbers, webhooks, media.
blocker: Meta app review/business verification for production

one_liner: Cloud phone system with public REST API.
auth_notes: Basic (api_id/api_token) for own account; OAuth2 only for listed Technology Partners.
access_notes: API key created by company admin in dashboard (needs Aircall account; no free tier confirmed). Third-party OAuth requires marketplace partnership.
api_notes: Users, calls, conversations, numbers, contacts, messaging, dialer, AI agents, webhooks; 120 req/min.

one_liner: Programmable communications APIs with official MCP servers.
auth_notes: API key/secret (Basic), RS256 JWT from application private key, signature secret.
access_notes: Signup gives API key/secret in dashboard; free trial credit not confirmed on fetched pages.
api_notes: SMS, voice, verify, numbers, applications, reports.

one_liner: Google Ads API (gRPC/REST) with official MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (service account or user flows). Developer tokens sunset Sept 9 2026 and are ignored.
access_notes: New Cloud project gets Test access (test accounts only); production needs Explorer/Basic/Standard access via brand verification and review (Basic automated, Standard manual).
api_notes: Full campaign/ads/reporting management.

one_liner: Meta Marketing API with official Meta Ads MCP.
auth_notes: OAuth scopes ads_read/ads_management; system-user tokens.
access_notes: Apps start at Limited Access (dev only, rate-limited); Full Access needs App Review and 500 calls/<15% errors; managing others' accounts needs advanced access; business verification may be required.
api_notes: Campaigns, ads, catalogs, insights via Graph/Marketing API.

one_liner: LinkedIn Marketing/Advertising API.
auth_notes: 3-legged OAuth only; scopes r_ads, rw_ads, r_ads_reporting; no client credentials for marketing.
access_notes: Advertising API product must be approved for the developer app (Development Tier, up to 5 ad accounts); further tiers need review.
api_notes: Ad accounts, campaigns, creatives, reporting, organizations.

one_liner: HighLevel CRM with OAuth marketplace apps and official MCP.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 auth-code via Marketplace app (agency/location tokens). Private Integration Tokens exist but fetched page was empty.
access_notes: Free developer account to create marketplace apps; installing/testing needs a HighLevel account/sub-account; plan requirements not stated in fetched docs.
api_notes: Contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities, payments, locations etc.
human_reason: Plan/trial requirement for test accounts and Private Integration Token details not confirmed from primary docs.

one_liner: Marketing API with API key and OAuth2.
auth_notes: API key via basic auth; OAuth2 for registered apps.
access_notes: Mailchimp account required; free-tier API access not stated on fetched pages. Register app in account for OAuth.
api_notes: Marketing API: audiences, campaigns, automations, reports; client SDKs. Official MCP at mailchimp.com/developer/_mcp/server is docs-search only (no account access).

one_liner: Klaviyo REST API with official remote MCP.
auth_notes: Private API key (pk_, scoped) in Authorization header; OAuth for app-marketplace partners.
access_notes: Account owner/admin/manager creates keys; free plan/plan gating not stated on fetched page.
api_notes: Profiles, lists, campaigns, flows, events, catalogs, etc.

one_liner: All-in-one funnel/email platform with small public API and built-in MCP.
auth_notes: X-API-Key header; up to 3 keys created in Settings.
access_notes: Key created under profile Settings > MCP & API keys; plan gating for API/MCP not stated in help docs.
api_notes: Contacts, tags, with some further operations; funnels not editable via MCP.
human_reason: Plan requirements and full endpoint list not confirmed; MCP described only in help article.

one_liner: Pinterest API v5 with OAuth2 and newly announced MCP.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code; trial tokens expire in 24h.
access_notes: Business account; app request reviewed for Trial access, then Standard access upgrade review for production.
api_notes: Pins, boards, ads, analytics, catalogs (v5).
human_reason: MCP availability/URL from third-party blog; Pinterest announcement page gave no details; GA status unclear.

one_liner: Threads API for publishing, replies, insights.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 short-lived (1h) then long-lived (60d) tokens; scopes threads_basic, threads_content_publish, etc.
access_notes: Meta app with Threads use case; Threads testers can grant permissions without review; other users need App Review and published app.
api_notes: Publish, reply management, read replies, insights.

one_liner: Twilio SendGrid v3 email API.
auth_notes: API key as Bearer token with per-key permissions.
access_notes: Free plan retired (May 2025); new accounts get a trial per secondary sources; paid plans otherwise. Trial terms not on primary pages.
api_notes: Mail send, templates, contacts, marketing, stats, suppression.
